page.layout: One page of text, centred: a decorative ornament at the top, then a title block of dedication, a centred italic paragraph, and a signature line at the lower right. No running head, page number or margin notes.

main_text.head: VIRO Amplissimo, Magnificentissimo, Generosissimo, Consultissimo, prosapia pariter ac virtutis nobilitate splendidissimo DOMINO, DN. SIGISMUNDO AB ERLACH, Totius Helveticae militiae Generalissimo, Florent. Reip. Bernen. Consuli gravissimo, prudentissimo, Patri patriae, Domino atque Baroni in Spiez clementissimo, suo è sacro baptismatis fonte susceptori benignissimo ac Patrono summo, nullis non honoribus perpetim prosequendo, colendo;

p.i: Ea quà par est animi submissione qualecunque hoc humilimi cultûs ac debitæ observantiæ monumentum erigere voluit, ut debuit

page.notes: The small ornament at the top is a printed decoration, not text. The faint mirrored text near the foot (a library stamp and show-through from the other side of the leaf) was left out.
